items.title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Human Flourishing
items.description: About the Team The Human Flourishing team’s mission is to ensure AI systems understand and advance human flourishing. As AI becomes more capable and plays a larger role in people’s lives, we want its human benefits to grow with its capabilities. The Human Flourishing team is part of the broader Post Training organization. Our approach has two parts. Firstly, we measure and improve models’ understanding, capability, and propensity to act according to people’s values and to help them achieve their long-term goals. Secondly, we directly scale tangible impact for users in human domains like education and mental health, working across research, product, and partnerships to increase the benefits over a billion people experience weekly when they use ChatGPT. Our recent work includes Beneficial RL https://alignment.openai.com/beneficial-rl/, which investigates how training for beneficial behavior generalizes across settings, and MentalHealthBench https://openai.com/index/introducing-mentalhealthbench/, a benchmark developed with mental health experts to evaluate realistic conversations. About the Role We’re looking for an exceptional, hands-on researcher to turn difficult-to-define signals of long-term flourishing into measurable improvements in model behavior. You’ll help set research direction, build what is needed to test your ideas, and drive successful work into the models and products we ship. We’re especially interested in researchers with deep experience improving frontier models through pretraining or reinforcement learning (RL) / post-training, especially on less verifiable problems, or researchers who combine strong LLM skills with deep expertise in domains like education or mental health. Prior experience in these domains is not required. In this role, you will - Develop scalable training methods across the training stack that improve how models understand people’s values, support their agency, and help them achieve long-term goals. - Lead high-leverage research from an open question to a shipped improvement: choose a hard-to-define problem, iteratively define success, run experiments, and integrate into frontier models. - Build RL environments for difficult-to-verify outcomes, and study whether beneficial behavior generalizes across settings. - Create evaluations grounded in human expertise and feedback that reveal capability gaps, unintended incentives in RL, and failures that aggregate scores can miss. - Test whether measures of model behavior predict better learning, wellbeing, and other long-term outcomes, and use those findings to guide training. - Build new 0→1 capabilities in human domains that may have an increasing impact with upcoming increases in model intelligence and test-time compute. - Partner with product teams, engineers, partnerships teams, and domain experts to deploy promising methods, measure their effects in real use, and turn what you learn into further improvements. - Assess AI’s impacts on human flourishing at the scale of over a billion users. You might thrive in this role if you - Care deeply about helping AI improve people’s lives, and feel this is a responsibility that comes with increasingly capable models. - Have an unusually strong research record in pretraining or RL / post-training research, especially in a hard-to-verify area; or combine strong LLM research skills with deep expertise in education, mental health, or a related field of human benefit. - Are a hands-on builder who can turn ideas into rigorous experiments, write and debug code, and work directly with data and training infrastructure. - Have the taste to choose consequential problems and actionable steps on the path to solving those problems. - Take ownership of ambiguous problems and choose methods based on the impact they can deliver, including when the most useful work is unglamorous. - Care about whether a capability will scale, generalize, and make it into the real world—not just whether it can be shown in a paper or prototype. - Work well across disciplines and can grok the most important bottlenecks to scaling our impact in a multidisciplinary problem. If you’re excited about ensuring AI systems advance human flourishing, we’d love to hear from you. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . The Enterprise Applications and Architecture (EAA) team builds the internal platforms, systems, and workflows that help Coinbase operate effectively at scale. Within that space, this Product Manager role will focus on FP&A and adjacent finance workflows, with ownership across planning, forecasting, reporting, workflow automation, and the systems experience that finance teams rely on day to day. This is a high-ownership L5 PM role for a leader who can bring structure to a broad problem space and partner effectively across Finance, Engineering, Business Systems, Data, and Functional Architecture. The scope spans core planning workflows like budgeting, forecasting, headcount management, and close-adjacent processes, along with reporting, variance analysis, executive visibility, and platform-level improvements that make FP&A tooling more scalable, reliable, and AI-enabled over time. What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties): Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for FP&A product surfaces and workflows across planning, reporting, and automation. Partner closely with Finance and EAA leadership to define the future-state FP&A operating model and the product investments required to support it. Drive improvements to budgeting, forecasting, headcount planning, and finance operating rhythms through better systems, workflows, and user experiences. Improve reporting and insight delivery for finance and business leaders by shaping dashboards, variance analysis experiences, and decision-support tooling. Lead platform-level product work that improves the scalability, maintainability, and interoperability of FP&A systems and workflows. Identify and prioritize opportunities to use AI and workflow automation to reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and shorten planning and reporting cycles. Translate ambiguous stakeholder needs into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and sequenced delivery plans. Operate as the product DRI across multiple teams, ensuring alignment on priorities, tradeoffs, timing, and business impact. Define success metrics and use quantitative and qualitative signals to continuously improve outcomes for Finance users. What we look for in you (ie. job requirements): 5+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of complex internal platforms, enterprise software, or workflow-heavy products. Strong product judgment in cross-functional environments with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and high expectations for execution. Experience working on finance systems, planning platforms, enterprise workflows, or adjacent domains where process rigor and data quality matter. Ability to deeply understand user pain points across both operational workflows and executive reporting use cases. Strong analytical orientation with the ability to define metrics, evaluate tradeoffs, and use data to inform roadmap decisions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders and align technical and non-technical partners. Demonstrated ability to move ambiguous problem spaces toward clear product strategy and execution. Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human-in-the-loop practices to deliver business-ready outputs and measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, and cost. Demonstrated AI and workflow automation fluency, especially in environments where automation can materially improve finance operations. Nice to haves: Experience supporting FP&A, Finance, or business operations teams with internal product or systems work. Familiarity with planning, forecasting, reporting, enterprise performance management, or close-adjacent finance workflows. Experience with data and analytics products, including dashboarding and KPI instrumentation. Experience partnering with enterprise architecture, business systems, or platform engineering teams. Familiarity with fintech, regulated environments, or high-growth technology companies. Curiosity about crypto and willingness to ramp quickly on Coinbase products and business context. items.location_text: Poland, Peru, Latvia, Colombia, Argentina, Romania, Slovenia, Lithuania, South Africa, Czech Republic, Estonia, Hungary, Mexico, Chile, Slovakia, Bulgaria
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The Consumer team owns the Kraken app experience used by millions of traders and crypto newcomers worldwide, the product that turns someone's first crypto curiosity into a long-term relationship with Kraken. We build the interfaces people actually use to buy, sell, manage their portfolio, and interact with their assets. Our stack is React on web and React Native on mobile, and we ship fast, measure everything, and iterate based on real user behaviour. We work agile, globally distributed, and we care as much about why we build something as how we build it. We're looking for a world-class Senior Frontend Engineer to join our product-minded engineering team: we care about customer problems, measurable outcomes, frontend craft, and fast iteration. We work across web and mobile surfaces, partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Platform teams, and use experimentation, observability, and user behaviour to guide what we build next. THE OPPORTUNITY - Design, develop, and maintain high-quality consumer-facing features across web (React) and mobile (React Native), owning the full experience from concept to production monitoring. - Own the full lifecycle of product work, from discovery and technical design through release, monitoring, experimentation, and iteration. - Drive A/B testing and experimentation strategies forming hypotheses, designing experiments, analysing results, and iterating based on data. - Partner with Product, Design, Data, and Mobile engineers to create coherent experiences across Kraken’s consumer surfaces. - Make opinionated technical decisions on framework and architecture choices (we want engineers who have strong views on things like TanStack Router vs Next.js App Router and can back them up with real experience). - Set the standard for high-quality code — functional correctness, accessibility, performance, and testability are non-negotiables. - Mentor engineers across seniority levels and contribute to a culture of craft and continuous improvement. - Lead and collaborate on complex cross-platform initiatives, driving alignment across web and mobile surfaces. - Stay ahead of the curve on React ecosystem tooling, React Server Components, concurrent features, streaming, and bring those insights back to the team. - Work AI-natively, we use AI tools across the full SDLC and expect engineers to have a structured, opinionated workflow, not just autocomplete. WHAT YOU BRING - 6+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on consumer-facing web and/or mobile products. - Deep expertise in TypeScript and the React ecosystem, you have opinions about state management, data fetching patterns, and component architecture, and you can articulate the trade-offs. - Production experience with React Native and cross-platform mobile development, including App Store and Google Play release pipelines. - Experience with Next.js — specifically familiarity with App Router, React Server Components, and the client/server boundary decisions that come with them. - Hands-on experience with A/B testing, feature flags, and experimentation frameworks (LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, or similar). - Experience with WebSockets or Server-Sent Events for real-time UI updates. - Strong testing culture Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress, and the judgement to know when to use each. - Familiarity with modern build tooling (Vite, Webpack, CI/CD pipelines) and performance profiling. - Experience in fintech, crypto, payments, or other high-trust consumer products where correctness and user confidence matter. - Strong written and verbal English, you can write a clear RFC, give direct feedback in a PR review, and explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder. - An active AI-assisted development workflow, Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent with the engineering rigour to review and own what gets produced. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. items.title: Head of Fraud
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market, and trust in every account, deposit and trade is core to the product. As Head of Fraud, you will own Polymarket's fraud risk end to end: defining the strategy, building preventative and detective controls, and making sure every finding is resolved. Your scope covers first-party fraud (customers abusing the platform themselves) and third-party fraud (bad actors targeting our users and systems, including account takeover). You will hold the bar for what good looks like both commercially and in the eyes of our regulators, and you will move fast. You will partner with and influence Product owners and engineers you don't manage build and ship most fraud controls, so influencing them is critical to success in this role. You'll also work closely with Compliance, Legal, Data, Payments, Customer Support and Security. WHAT YOU'LL OWN Strategy and risk ownership - Own the fraud risk framework and appetite, and set the roadmap to deliver it. - Maintain a living fraud risk assessment and typology library across onboarding, funding, trading and withdrawals. - Report fraud exposure, losses, control performance and emerging threats to senior leadership and governance forums. Preventative and detective controls - Partner with Product and Engineering to assess fraud risk before new products, payment methods, promotions, and material feature changes launch. - Define and implement controls that stop fraud before it happens: identity and device signals, step-up authentication, velocity and limit rules, and payment and withdrawal checks. - Build detective controls that surface fraud fast: monitoring rules, ML and AI models, anomaly detection, alerting and case management. - Tune controls continuously against loss rates, false positives and customer friction. Fraud types in scope - First-party fraud: chargeback and friendly fraud, promotion and referral abuse, ACH fraud, multi-accounting, and identity misrepresentation by genuine customers. - Third-party fraud: account takeover, synthetic and stolen identities, stolen payment methods, phishing, social engineering, scams, and organized fraud rings. Findings and resolution - Own investigations, from triage to root cause to closure. - Make sure every finding from monitoring, audits, regulatory exams and incidents has an owner, a fix and a deadline, and is closed out. - Feed lessons back into product, controls and policy so issues don't recur. Team and partnership - Build and lead a high-performing fraud team of analysts, investigators and fraud data specialists. - Drive delivery through Product and Engineering: shape their roadmaps, win prioritization for fraud work, and design prevention into features from day one. - Work with Compliance and Legal on regulatory expectations, SAR-related escalations and exam readiness. - Select and manage fraud vendors and tooling. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Influence is the most critical skill for this role, and we'll assess it at every interview stage. - Exceptional influence. You have a track record of getting fraud controls shipped by product and engineering teams you don't manage. You build trust fast, make a clear case using data, win prioritization against competing roadmaps, and turn disagreement into decisions. - Deep fraud expertise. 10+ years of experience in fraud within fintech, payments, banking, crypto, trading, online gaming, or other high-volume digital platforms, including at least five years in leadership, with direct accountability for fraud prevention, investigations, operations, and measurable outcomes. - Control design that works. A track record of building preventative and detective controls from scratch and proving they cut losses without hurting good customers. - Breadth across fraud types. Hands-on experience with both first-party and third-party fraud, including account takeover, identity fraud and payment fraud. - AI native. You use AI and automation as your default way of working: for detection models, investigation tooling, case triage and your own day-to-day productivity. You know where models beat rules and where they don't. - Commercial judgement. You understand that the goal is the right balance of loss, friction and growth, not zero fraud. You can put a number on the trade-offs. - Regulatory lens. You know what regulators expect from a fraud program (governance, documentation, testing, escalation) and can defend our approach in an exam. - Pace and ownership. You drive outcomes quickly, prioritize ruthlessly and close things out. You're comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. - Data fluency. Comfortable working directly in SQL and with data teams to size problems and measure control performance. NICE TO HAVE - Experience at a regulated exchange, derivatives venue or broker, or at a crypto platform with on-chain and fiat flows. - Familiarity with blockchain analytics and wallet-level risk signals. - Exposure to market abuse and trade surveillance, and how it intersects with fraud. - Experience building fraud capability across multiple jurisdictions. - Hands-on experience shipping LLM or agent-based tooling for investigations. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $500,000 to $600,000 plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

items.title: People Tech & Analytics Engineer
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a People Tech & Analytics Engineer on the People team, you will build the systems, data pipelines, and automations behind how Mistral runs People Operations. Reporting to the People Tech & Analytics Lead, you will turn the roadmap into reality: wiring our HR tech stack together, making data flow reliably between systems, and automating people processes with third-party tools as well as Mistral's own models, agents, and APIs. This is an individual contributor role for someone who loves building. You will spend most of your time in the systems and the data, deep-diving into problems: connecting HRIS, ATS, payroll, identity, and finance tools, standing up the data layer behind our people metrics, and shipping automations that remove manual work from the People team. If you are a data engineer or people technology specialist who wants to deliver meaningful automation outcomes at Europe's largest AI company, this is the role for you. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Build, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations and data pipelines across our HR systems (HRIS, ATS, payroll, identity and finance), run data quality checks, and fix inconsistencies at the source. - Implement and evolve the Metabase visualisation layer of our people data lake, build the dashboards and self-serve reporting managers and People partners rely on, as well as the context layer on HR data, supporting the move to conversational insights in collaboration with the Data team. - Design, build, test and document automated workflows, mainly with Mistral's own models, agents and APIs, with human review wherever decisions affect people, monitor live automations with alerting, error handling, logging and runbooks, and prototype AI use cases on people processes, productionising the ones that prove their worth. - Implement configuration changes across the HR tech stack (workflows, fields, roles and permissions, new countries and entities), support testing and rollout of system changes and integrations, and act as first-line troubleshooter for the People team, leading issue resolution through to production with a clear audit trail. - Architect end-to-end HR workflows with key stakeholders in HR Operations, Business Partnering and Reward, and implement data governance in practice: quality standards, access controls, retention rules and audit trails for employee data. - Provide clear enablement materials in Notion so the People team and managers can use our systems confidently, with strong tier-1 support via a bot. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Experience in analytics engineering or HR technology, ideally within an HR or People function or working closely with one as a stakeholder. - Strong practical SQL: you are comfortable building pipelines and transformations yourself. - Hands-on experience with HR systems such as Ashby, and integrating them with ATS, payroll, identity and finance tools via APIs, middleware and data pipelines. - Real automation experience: you have built and maintained workflows in n8n or similar tools such as Make, Zapier, Workato or Langdock, and you are excited to do the same with Mistral's own models and tooling. - Working experience with data warehousing (Snowflake, BigQuery) and the modern data stack (dbt or similar), and with visualisation tools such as Metabase, Looker, Tableau or Power BI. - You are low-ego and team-spirited, and you take a prioritised problem and run with it in ambiguity: you would rather build a first version and iterate than wait for a perfect spec. You start from the HR need, not the technology, stay hands-on, and have a track record of building foundations in growing organisations without creating legacy. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. items.title: AI Operations Engineer, Enterprise Tech
items.location_text: Bellevue, WA; Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Corporate Engineering team is building and scaling the next generation of enterprise AI infrastructure at Robinhood. Our mission is to make AI capabilities reliable, secure, and accessible across the company, enabling teams to build, deploy, and operate intelligent solutions at scale. From enterprise LLM integrations to agentic workflows and hybrid cloud infrastructure, we're creating the foundation that supports how Robinhood leverages AI internally. As an AI Operations Engineer, Enterprise Tech, you'll help support, maintain, and improve the AI platforms and infrastructure used by teams across Robinhood. You'll work hands-on with LLM integrations, automation, monitoring, and production systems, partnering with engineers and internal users to troubleshoot issues and build solutions that make our AI capabilities more reliable and easier to use. This is an opportunity to grow your expertise in AI infrastructure while contributing to a rapidly evolving area of Corporate Engineering. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, and Bellevue, WA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Build internal tooling, automation, and self-service solutions that streamline AI operations, reduce manual intervention, and improve the developer experience. Support and maintain enterprise AI platforms and infrastructure across cloud-based and on-premises environments, helping ensure reliable performance and availability. Troubleshoot technical issues involving LLM integrations, APIs, model behavior, and system performance, working directly with developers and internal teams to identify and resolve problems. Support enterprise LLM integrations, including Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, helping monitor API usage, token consumption, performance, and reliability. Implement and maintain monitoring, observability, and deployment workflows for AI systems, identifying issues and opportunities to improve operational efficiency. Collaborate with Product, Software Engineering, Business Systems, and AI Strategy teams to gather feedback, investigate recurring issues, and improve the reliability and usability of enterprise AI solutions. What you bring Experience in IT Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, or AI infrastructure and support, with a track record of operating complex production systems. Practical experience working with AI platforms, LLM integrations, or AI-powered applications, including exposure to Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or similar models. Working knowledge of Linux administration and experience writing scripts or automation using Python, Bash, or similar languages. Familiarity with infrastructure management, configuration, or orchestration tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or Kubernetes. Experience troubleshooting production systems, investigating technical issues, and working with monitoring or observability tools. Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and an interest in learning emerging AI technologies and infrastructure. Ability to communicate technical issues clearly and collaborate with developers, engineers, and internal stakeholders. Bonus: Exposure to GPU infrastructure, AI workload orchestration, vector databases, RAG applications, agentic frameworks, or hybrid cloud environments. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $132,000 — $155,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $116,000 — $136,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $103,000 — $121,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Commercial Counsel - Brazil
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our Legal Team in Brazil. In this role, you will support complex commercial transactions with a primary focus on Brazil and support for other LATAM countries, including SaaS, licensing, and strategic partnerships, while helping the company navigate diverse legal and regulatory frameworks in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence. You will work closely with global colleagues to provide practical, business-oriented advice that enables growth while managing risk across multiple jurisdictions. WHO YOU ARE - Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, have a strong sense of ownership with enthusiasm for applying your legal expertise to cutting-edge products. - Experienced in navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments, with the ability to manage ambiguity and make informed, timely decisions. - Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and global colleagues. - Proactive, business-minded, and committed to delivering practical solutions that support both compliance and commercial success. - Hunger to be exceptional at your job. Requests are long-running, streaming and expensive. One prompt can cost a few cents or a few dollars. One team's burst can burn another team's budget. Providers change their rate limits, failure modes and pricing without warning. Running this well is a problem few companies have solved, and it's the job. - Own the reliability of the platform engineers depend on: the AI Gateway, the agent runtime and the connections to internal tools. Routing decisions affect both latency and spend, and you'll own the tradeoff directly. - Work with Security, Finance and AI governance to put access controls, budgets, audit logging and data handling into the platform, not into a spreadsheet next to it. - Lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews. items.title: Lead Data Engineer
items.description: We’re looking for an Lead Data Engineer to join the Paid Media Insights team within Better Collective. The Domanin Paid media is where the data has to pay off. We spend real money across dozens of ad networks every day. Which campaigns scale, which creatives get cut and which markets get budget comes out of this team’s models. Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue and CRM, stitched into one user-level view of what a click was worth. That model exists and it works. The most demanding domain on our platform: the most sources, the fastest schema churn, the shortest patience for a late table. We want the engineer who owns it. Where this role sits A central platform team sets the how. You set the what. A central team owns the platform - MotherDuck, dbt, Dagster, DLT, the infrastructure. Paid Media Insights is a spoke in that hub and spoke organisation, building on it. The split is deliberate: the platform team decides how data is produced, you decide what paid media produces and own everything we run. No new stack to build, and no year lost to plumbing a central team should solve once. Be a demanding customer: when a golden path does not fit paid media, push for it to change rather than quietly building around it. You report to the Senior Head of Paid Media Insights and work across Paid Media, with the Campaign, Commercial, CRM and platform teams. What you will own Every data job in paid media. All of it. Freshness, cost, reliability, alerting, and the 07:30 incident before the spend review. A paid media model that is wrong or late is yours, not the platform team’s - that accountability is the core of the role. The end-to-end user-level model. Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue and CRM, joined into one view the business trusts enough to move budget on. Ingestion of paid media sources on the platform’s framework: which sources, which schemas, and what happens when a network changes its API unannounced. The domain’s models, from staging to the marts analysts query, plus the semantic meaning on top. Nobody at the centre can define a qualified signup in paid media. You can. Reverse ETL into the ad platforms, so conversion data lands where it changes bidding. The handover, taking over the paid media jobs the central team still runs for us. What you will lead A group of engineers, and the standard they build to Technical lead for the data engineers in Paid Media Insights: setting the standard for how this domain builds, reviewing, unblocking, and growing them by giving away the interesting problems. Shaping the domain’s roadmap with the Senior Head of Paid Media Insights, the analysts and the business teams. Representing paid media in platform conversations, including how we support machine learning and data science. Hands-on technical leadership, not a step away from building. You will be in the code. What we’re looking for More than a stack match, we are looking for a particular way of working. You take ownership, and it shows up in the boring parts. You want the pager as well as the model, and would rather own a domain end to end than hand off the consequences. You break complex systems into simple parts. Attribution windows, late conversions, identity across platforms, dozens of disagreeing source APIs - you hold that and still hand the business something it can reason about. You raise the people around you. Colleagues come to you for technical advice. You review generously, give feedback that lands, and would rather the whole team understand the pipeline than be the only one who does. You work well with a platform team. Strong opinions about standards, still happy to work inside someone else’s. You know a constraint worth fighting from a preference worth dropping. You are already past prompting. AI is part of how you engineer, and you have a view on what a data domain needs to be for agents to be useful on top of it: documented, standardised, semantically clear. You are close to the business. You will sit with the marketers and analysts spending budget on what you build, and can talk data with people who do not think in tables. You are technically deep where it counts. Production pipelines in SQL and Python, dbt and Dagster, cloud data warehousing, and a real feel for performance, cost and reliability at scale. Paid media or attribution experience is a bonus. Our Stack What you will build on MotherDuck / DuckDB · dbt · Dagster · DLT · Python · SQL · AWS · reverse ETL and semantic layer tooling We do not expect you to have worked with all of these. If you have built production pipelines on Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift and you are curious about where we are going, that transfers. Benefits Private health insurance Sick leave 100% paid Canteen with free meals and drinks Flexible working hours Additional vacation days after two years in the company We also provide up-to date equipment, entertainment facilities in a modern office right in the city center and more. Application Deadline We look forward to hearing from you and accept applications until 28th November. Please submit your CV and cover letter in PDF; only applications submitted in English will be considered. Expected start date: as soon as possible.

items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As part of our growing Data Science and Analytics team, you will play an instrumental role in our company's mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by driving data-informed decision making across our organization. You bring experience from high-bar teams and are eager to help shape the norms and best practices of a growing data science team as Anthropic continues to scale. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to informing our strategy as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world. You'll be the senior data science leader for Model Experience and a strategic thought partner to product, engineering, and research leaders. Working where frontier AI research reaches the public, you'll help shape model roadmap and launch decisions, bringing a point of view on how users experience our models and what good looks like beyond benchmark scores. As a tech lead manager, you'll also hire and manage a team of data scientists, setting their agenda, personally leading the highest-stakes analyses, and raising the bar for how data shapes model and product decisions. Responsibilities: Act as a strategic thought partner to product, engineering, and research leaders, helping shape model roadmap priorities, launch decisions, and the major bets the team makes Set the data science agenda for Model Experience, deciding where the team can have the most impact on model development and launch decisions and what it should deprioritize Hire, manage, and develop a team of data scientists, coaching them to move from answering questions to shaping decisions Frame the most important and ambiguous questions about model quality and user experience, size the opportunities, and make clear recommendations, including when they challenge the current direction Define how Model Experience measures success, establishing the core metrics and measurement frameworks across external products and internal testing that align teams and leadership on what matters Set the standard for experimentation and causal inference across Model Experience, including where launches lack a clean A/B test, and personally lead the highest-stakes analyses Turn complex analyses of model and user behavior into clear narratives and recommendations that drive decisions with senior leadership and cross-functional partners Establish foundational data practices and shape the analytics infrastructure Model Experience needs to support rapid iteration and decision-making as our models and products evolve You may be a good fit if you: Have extensive experience in data science, including leading analytics for a product or research area at significant scale Have 3+ years managing data science teams, including setting team direction, hiring, and developing senior data scientists Have been a trusted partner to senior product, research, and business leaders, with clear examples of changing a roadmap or high-stakes decision Bring strong product sense and business judgment, including the ability to frame the right question and take a position with incomplete information Have deep expertise in experimental design, causal inference, and statistical modeling at high scale, with enough fluency in Python and SQL to stay hands-on and guide others' technical work Communicate clearly in writing and in presentations, including to executive audiences Have a bias for action and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive progress Care about the company's mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI Strong candidates may also have: Experience with AI/ML products, large language models, or developer tools in the AI/ML ecosystem Experience as a tech lead manager or player-coach, balancing hands-on technical work with people management Experience building or scaling a data science team in a fast-growing organization Experience working closely with Product or Research teams, especially on LLM or AI products Comfort working with unstructured data The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $460,000 — $460,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. You will establish design criteria, review complex fire protection systems, coordinate with authorities and delivery partners, and ensure that fire and life-safety requirements remain clear from early design through construction, commissioning, and operational handover. items.title: Member of Technical Staff (Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure)
items.location_text: San Francisco, Remote (United States), Seattle, New York City
items.description: Perplexity serves hundreds of millions of queries a month. Every answer, every Perplexity Computer task, and every enterprise deployment runs on production infrastructure owned by the Cloud Infrastructure team: a fleet of Kubernetes clusters across a multi-account AWS estate, private networks that reach hyperscalers and the neoclouds serving our models, and the storage underneath our user data and agentic workloads. We're looking for SREs who treat reliability as a software problem. You'll own compute, networking, and storage at scale and keep production stable while everything built on top of it is changing fast. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own production at scale. Run the compute, networking, and storage foundation behind Perplexity's consumer, Computer, API, and enterprise products, and own its availability, latency, and cost. - Run our Kubernetes fleet. Operate and upgrade the EKS clusters that host web services, search, datastores, and secure sandboxes. Tune scheduling, autoscaling, node lifecycle, DNS, and service networking so clusters stay healthy under bursty, fast-growing load. - Engineer the network. Design and operate VPC architectures, Transit Gateway and PrivateLink connectivity, load balancing, DNS, and egress across accounts, regions, and cloud providers. - Keep data durable and fast. Own the storage layer (EBS, S3, DynamoDB, and the managed databases and caches our services depend on), including performance, durability, backups, and restores that have actually been tested. - Manage everything as code. Run infrastructure through Terraform and CI/CD. Build reusable modules and guardrails, and make every change reviewable, repeatable, and safe to roll back. - Prepare for failures. Define SLOs, build alerts that someone can act on, design for zone and regional failure, and run game days and disaster-recovery exercises that prove recovery works. - Lead incident response. Be on the critical path when things break. Drive incidents to resolution, write blameless postmortems, and land the fixes so the same failure never pages anyone twice. - Scale ahead of demand. Own capacity planning, quotas, reservations, and cost efficiency so product launches and traffic spikes never wait on infrastructure. - Automate away the toil. Build tooling, increasingly agent-driven, that turns provisioning, upgrades, and remediation into self-serve, hands-off workflows for every engineering team. QUALIFICATIONS We expect you to have real depth in most of these: - Deep AWS expertise. You know VPC, IAM, EC2, EKS, ELB, Route 53, S3, EBS, etc. well past the console, including their limits, failure modes, and the bill that comes with them. - Production Kubernetes at scale: cluster upgrades, CNI, CoreDNS, autoscalers like Karpenter, and debugging a misbehaving node at 3 a.m. Writing Helm charts alone doesn't count. - Terraform mastery. You've designed module structures, managed state across many accounts, and run large refactors and imports without taking production down. - Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, load balancing, routing). - You write real code in Python, Go, or Rust for automation, tooling, and controllers, and you'd rather automate a runbook than follow it. - Fluency with observability tools like Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana, and the judgment to turn metrics, logs, and traces into SLOs and alerts that matter. - A track record of leading production incidents and turning root-cause analysis into durable fixes. - You own problems end-to-end and do well when the path forward isn't laid out for you. ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE WE VALUE - Multi-region active-active or failover architectures, and disaster-recovery programs with real recovery targets. - Proxies, service meshes, and kernel-level networking: Envoy, Istio, Cilium, or eBPF. - GitOps and progressive delivery: Argo CD, Flux, or similar. - Enterprise and compliance environments: single-tenant or BYOC deployments, KMS/BYOK, SOC 2 or similar controls. - Running stateful systems in production: Postgres, Redis, or search engines like Vespa or Elasticsearch. - Multi-cloud or neocloud operations (GCP, CoreWeave, or similar). - FinOps: cost attribution, Savings Plans and reservations, and making infrastructure cheaper without making it fragile.

items.title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, GPU Cluster Infrastructure)
items.location_text: San Francisco, Remote (United States), Toronto, Seattle, New York City
items.description: Perplexity serves hundreds of millions of queries a month, and every one of them fans out into multiple AI inference requests running in real time. Behind that sits a large GPU fleet spread across several cloud providers. Today, our inference engineers and researchers build models while also managing networking, securing capacity, and operating the underlying GPU clusters, responsibilities we want a dedicated platform team to own. Your job is to take ownership of that infrastructure and hide its complexity behind a unified, self-serve platform for running training and inference workloads. RESPONSIBILITIES - Build a self-serve compute platform. Design and own the systems that let inference engineers and researchers launch training jobs and operate inference services without managing GPU provisioning, cluster configuration, or provider-specific infrastructure. - Operate the GPU fleet. Own provisioning, lifecycle management, reliability, and capacity integration across providers, giving teams a consistent way to use compute regardless of where it runs. - Solve for GPU scarcity. Build the scheduling and placement logic that finds available capacity across providers, packs it efficiently, and gets the right workload onto the right hardware under real constraints. - Support two very different workloads. Keep long-running distributed training jobs healthy while simultaneously guaranteeing the availability and latency of production inference services on the same fleet. - Own the Kubernetes for GPU orchestration. Write the operators and CRDs, and manage many clusters across providers so the platform behaves the same everywhere we run. - Make failure boring. Build the fault tolerance, autoscaling, and observability that keep the fleet utilized and let workloads survive node loss, provider hiccups, and capacity shifts without human intervention. - Set technical direction across teams. Partner with inference and cloud infrastructure engineers to turn operational constraints into a coherent platform architecture and roadmap. QUALIFICATIONS We expect you to have real depth in most of these: - Deep Kubernetes experience — custom operators, CRDs, and multi-cluster federation, not just running kubectl apply. - You've managed GPU clusters at scale: NVIDIA hardware, CUDA, and the networking that makes them fast (InfiniBand or RoCE). - You've orchestrated compute across multiple clouds (CoreWeave, AWS, GCP, or similar) and understand how different each one really is. - Strong distributed systems fundamentals: scheduling, resource allocation, and fault tolerance under load. - You write infrastructure and systems-level code in Go, Rust or C++. - You've supported both long-running training jobs and high-availability inference services, and you know why they pull infrastructure in opposite directions. - You own problems end-to-end and do well when the path forward isn't laid out for you. ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE WE VALUE - Inference serving stacks: vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM. - Slurm or other HPC schedulers. - GPU kernel work in CUDA or Triton — not required, but notable. - High-speed interconnects: InfiniBand, RoCE, or RDMA in production. - Observability for ML workloads: Prometheus, Grafana, or Weights & Biases.

items.title: Motion Designer
items.description: About the Team OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world. This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning. About the Role OpenAI is seeking a Motion Designer to help tell the stories behind our research. You’ll translate complex ideas, emerging capabilities, and the work of our researchers into clear, engaging motion across films, launches, demos, and other communications. Working within the creative team, you’ll partner with Research, Brand, and production teams to shape work from early concepts through final delivery. You’ll help determine what a story needs visually, explore different approaches, and bring those ideas to life through thoughtful design and animation. This is a hands-on role for someone with strong motion craft, curiosity about unfamiliar subjects, and the ability to find a compelling visual approach when the brief is still taking shape. You’ll contribute to how OpenAI’s research is expressed in motion, developing original work and reusable approaches that help the team build on what it learns. In this role, you will: - Develop motion concepts for research stories, working with creative partners and subject matter experts to understand the ideas and identify how best to communicate them. - Design and produce high-quality 2D and 3D motion for research films, launches, demos, and supporting content. - Apply and extend OpenAI’s visual and motion language, balancing consistency with the needs of each story. - Take work from visual exploration, storyboards, and animatics through animation, compositing, and final delivery. - Collaborate closely with designers, filmmakers, editors, producers, and researchers, bringing a motion perspective into the creative process early. - Translate technical or abstract concepts into visual sequences that are accessible to a broad audience while preserving the meaning of the underlying work. - Work with producers to scope projects, communicate dependencies, and maintain a high standard of craft as priorities and timelines evolve. - Present work clearly, explain creative decisions, and incorporate feedback from creative and technical partners. - Develop reusable assets, templates, and workflows where they improve quality and make recurring work easier to produce. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 7+ years of experience in motion design across films, campaigns, launches, or other narrative work. - A strong portfolio demonstrating design judgment, animation craft, and the ability to carry an idea from concept through finished execution. - The ability to explore an open-ended brief, propose a clear creative direction, and refine it through collaboration. - Proficiency in After Effects and experience with Cinema 4D or comparable 3D tools, alongside editing and compositing workflows. - Comfort working in Figma and sharing work across design and production teams. - A strong understanding of typography, composition, timing, rhythm, and visual storytelling. - Experience making complex or unfamiliar subjects understandable through design and motion. - Experience working with subject matter experts and incorporating technical feedback without losing clarity or creative quality. - Curiosity about AI and research, and a willingness to learn enough about a subject to represent it thoughtfully. items.title: Senior Client Partner - US
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? This is a rare thing in ad sales: you’ll be KICK’s first Senior Client Partner in the US. There’s no book to inherit. You’ll map the region, choose where we start and decide how KICK goes to market with agencies and advertisers, with a real say in what the product becomes. What you’ll build with us: Open the US market for KICK and own the revenue number. You’ll go beyond the media buy, into sponsorships and branded integrations campaigns. This is a full-time opportunity based in New York. You’ll work from home, but you won’t be working alone. You’ll be out in the market with agencies and advertisers, and closely connected to our Australian and Serbian teams as we build KICK’s US presence together. Who is Easygo and KICK? Easygo is a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands, including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. These brands have a fierce global following, but our crew is employed directly by Easygo, and that’s where the real fun happens. KICK is our live streaming platform, built to put creators and their communities first. It gives content creators 95% of their streaming income and has redefined what a live streaming platform can be. KICK started as a disruptor challenging the status quo. Since launching in 2022, it has grown to more than 100 million accounts, and 81.7% of its audience is aged 18 to 34. Creators stream on KICK across gaming, talk shows, podcasts, IRL, sport and events. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast, and who are ready to Unify, Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact, and that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Own and deliver KICK’s US revenue across video, display and native inventory Open the holding groups and the advertisers behind them, building trusted relationships from planning teams up to C-level Lead data driven strategy and storytelling, translating complex performance data into clear insights, recommendations, and narratives that influence senior decision makers and unlock upsell and cross sell opportunities. Build KICK’s US commercial story, using the audience, category and data-led proof points that get us onto plans Negotiate annual trading agreements, master agreements and multi-year spend commitments Own the pipeline and forecast, and grow the region year on year through retention, share of wallet and new accounts Mentor the team as it grows, and set the standard for how KICK sells in the region, and foster a culture of accountability, curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Your track record: 9+ years in digital media sales, with a proven record of owning and delivering a holding group or regional revenue number Established relationships across US agency groups, independents and key advertisers Experience negotiating trading agreements and multi-year commitments, and presenting to senior agency and client stakeholders Working knowledge of programmatic (PMPs, programmatic guaranteed, and DSP and SSP mechanics) Familiarity with CRM and order management systems (Boostr is a plus) Comfort building without an established process, in a function and region that are both being built Bonus points if you also have: Experience with creator networks, streaming, live broadcasting, entertainment or gaming platforms Relationships with programmatic buyers and brand-direct advertisers Here are our benefits and perks: Sharpening your edge The ultimate sandbox. Exciting, on-the-job learning opportunities. 1 in 3 of our people level up their roles every year. If you deliver, you move. Competitive pay and bonus scheme Market-synced pay that respects your craft and location. Performance-based bonus recognition based on your impact (up to 20%). Help us build our crew and get paid for it with our high-value referral bonus. Because great people know great people. Other perks 18 weeks of paid parental leave for primary carers, so you can be there for the moments that matter. Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage. Matched 401(k) contributions, so your future grows alongside your career. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge. #s-dni

items.title: Marketing Technology & Operations Lead, APAC
items.description: ABOUT OPENAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company committed to ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of AI capabilities while prioritizing safety, responsible deployment, and human needs. Our mission requires a team that represents a diversity of perspectives, voices, and experiences. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced JAPAC Marketing Operations Lead to build the operational foundations that connect regional B2B marketing activity to customer engagement, sales progression, and measurable business impact. This role serves as a critical bridge between global marketing and revenue operations and GEO B2B leaders, ensuring field leadership drives optimized customer journeys, measurement frameworks, and performance impact. It will deliver country level performance reporting and insights. Embedded in JAPAC’s GTM strategy, you will work closely with country marketing leads, GTM leaders, and Sales Operations to translate business priorities into a regional operations roadmap. You will represent JAPAC’s requirements with global Marketing Operations, ensuring that technology, data, and process decisions support local sales motions, customer journeys, and growth priorities. This is a hands-on role spanning the customer journey—from audience acquisition and database health through campaign execution, lead management, and performance reporting. You will combine technical fluency, analytical judgment, and strong cross-functional collaboration to help regional teams launch faster, improve follow-up, and understand what drives results. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Own the regional operations roadmap. Partner with JAPAC Marketing, GTM, and Sales Operations to consolidate country requirements, prioritize improvements against business goals, and represent regional needs in global MarkOps planning. - Manage regional marketing technology operations. Oversee the regional use of marketing automation, CRM, and event and webinar platforms. Work with global MarkOps and systems teams to troubleshoot issues, improve integrations, and validate changes across markets. - Build a healthier, more actionable database. Partner with GTM on priority-account and contact acquisition, enrichment, segmentation, and data quality. Improve opt-in coverage and marketability while maintaining appropriate consent and data-handling practices. - Own campaign setup, lead management, and sales handoffs. Set up and quality-check campaigns in marketing automation and CRM systems, including audience lists, registration forms, campaign tracking, and lead-capture workflows. Ensure leads from field events, webinars, and other campaigns enter the agreed qualification and routing processes. Work with Sales Operations, AEs, and SDRs to conduct regular reviews of untouched marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) and resolve routing or follow-up gaps. - Connect the customer journey. Work with regional marketers and global MarkOps to connect acquisition, engagement, nurture, and sales touchpoints, making relevant customer signals available to the teams that need to act on them. - Standardize campaign execution. Develop reusable templates, workflows, and quality checks that help field marketers launch campaigns quickly and consistently, with documented adaptations for local requirements. - Partner with Legal/Privacy and global MarkOps to embed market-specific data privacy and regulatory requirements across JAPAC into consent management, audience acquisition, campaign execution, and data handling. - Measure campaign performance and impact. Establish reliable reporting for field programs, local events, webinars, and account-based marketing. Apply shared measurement and attribution definitions to assess engagement, conversion, pipeline contribution, and ROI where the data supports it. - Enable regional teams. Train marketers on tools, campaign processes, data quality, and applicable privacy and compliance requirements. Provide practical support during JAPAC working hours and coordinate specialist guidance where needed. Partner with Sales Operations to jointly enable GTM teams on lead follow-up processes, ownership, and service-level agreements (SLAs). - Improve automation and operating efficiency. Identify repetitive work and partner with global teams to introduce dependable automation and AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual handoffs and improve execution. QUALIFICATIONS - 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing operations, marketing technology, revenue operations, or a closely related function. - Hands-on experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms, including Marketo and Salesforce, Adobe Experience Platform and familiarity with event or webinar technology. - Demonstrated experience improving database quality, segmentation, lead lifecycle processes, scoring, routing, and marketing-to-sales handoffs. - Strong analytical skills, with experience in campaign reporting, funnel analysis, attribution, and translating findings into operational improvements. - Experience supporting multiple markets and balancing global standards with regional business requirements. - Proven ability to work closely with Marketing, GTM, Sales Operations, and technical teams, influencing priorities and driving work through to completion. - Sound judgment around consent, customer data, privacy, and operational quality. NICE TO HAVE - Experience supporting JAPAC markets, including local campaign execution and collaboration across languages and time zones. - Experience with ABM, buying-group engagement, and enterprise, developer, or startup audiences. - Familiarity with data integrations, APIs, and customer engagement or product-usage signals. - Practical experience building or improving AI-enabled workflows and automation. items.title: Customer Experience Associate, Pathway
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The CXR Pathway Program is a paid program that launches your career in financial services. You'll be paid while you study for your SIE, Series 7 and Series 63 licenses and learn the job through hands-on, on-the-job training. You'll build foundational knowledge and confidence alongside your cohort, and finish the program ready to become a registered broker (Registered Representative). Learn by doing, from day one. While you study, you'll be on the job supporting customers across chat, email and phone, with needs ranging from simple to complex. We demonstrate insane customer focus, and you'll learn what that looks like in practice. As a member of this team, you'll be the company's voice and will use exceptional empathy and product expertise to ensure our users feel understood and valued. Your job is not only to help our customers, but to help us learn as a company from each interaction, so that we can make our customers' experience using our products as seamless as possible. This application is for our early talent with an anticipated start date in January 2027. We are looking for recent graduates who have customer-facing experience and are interested in becoming a Registered Representative through Robinhood's licensing and training program. Location: This role is based in our Denver, CO, and Westlake, TX offices, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week during the 6-month onboarding period. After onboarding, in-person attendance is expected at least 3 days a week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do CXR Pathway Program Outline Introduction to Licensing (with paid study time) Foundational Training & Proficiency Completion of Licensing Registered Representative Training & Proficiency Team Alignment & Production, which will include the following: Delivering an outstanding customer experience for customers through chat, email, and phone channels Driving continuous improvement to delight customers by acting as the voice of the customer by identifying and communicating improved ways to serve our customers Growing your financial services expertise as you develop proficiency in a range financial concepts What you bring Self-starter and ambitious learner who is comfortable with a fast-paced, evolving customer support landscape and embraces skill development through coaching, feedback, and goal setting Bachelor’s degree or experience working in the financial services industry is preferred Ready to demonstrate commitment and resilience over 26 weeks to achieve both licensing completion and Registered Representative proficiency Able to exercise independent thought and judgment, adapt to new tasks, and able to prioritize tasks in a multi-task environment Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a passion to support customers through various channels Effectiveness and willingness to adapt to customer experience delivery through phone and written channels Ability to quickly defuse customer anxiety through exceptional customer service skills Schedule flexibility as we evolve to meet the growing demands of our customers (future shift assignment may include evenings and weekend hours) Experience working in a customer support environment is preferred Available to start in early January 2027, with Pathway cohorts beginning Monday, January 11th and Monday, January 18th. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.
